drivingQuestion: On which teaching does R' Shimon's principle stand?
outcomeNote: Completes the locating of R' Shimon's first clause

segments.he: דְּקָאָמַר תַּנָּא קַמָּא לֹא יִכָּנֵס, וַאֲמַר לֵיהּ רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן יִכָּנֵס.
segments.en: With regard to «that which the first tanna said,» i.e., that «he» may «not enter, Rabbi Shimon said to» the tanna: «He» may «enter.» His reason, as stated, is that the limit does in fact extend that far, as any area the Sages granted to a person was actually permitted to him by Torah law.

moves.summary: R' Shimon's principle answers the first tanna's 'may not enter'
